description:
Discover the City Like Never Before
The A10 Pro is designed to redefine your city commuting experience with a perfect blend of style, functionality, and performance. Crafted with a lightweight yet robust 20” alloy frame, this city e-bike seamlessly navigates through busy streets, narrow alleyways, and everything in between. Whether you’re cruising through a park, heading to work, or exploring new spots in your neighborhood, the A10 Pro will get you there effortlessly and in style.
Comfort Meets Control
Equipped with a double comfort saddle, the A10 Pro ensures every ride feels like a breeze, no matter the distance. The steel front fork with lock-out technology absorbs road vibrations, giving you greater control and stability. This feature comes in handy for both smooth city roads and unexpected bumps along the way, allowing for a versatile ride tailored to your needs.
The hydraulic brake system adds an extra layer of safety, offering precise stopping power in any situation. Whether you need to come to an abrupt stop or gently slow down in high-traffic areas, you can trust the A10 Pro’s braking performance to be responsive and reliable.
Power Through Your Day
Battery: 36V 10Ah — The A10 Pro’s powerful battery is optimized for urban commutes, delivering consistent power throughout your journey. With a single charge, you can achieve a range of 28 to 37 miles, making it perfect for daily rides, quick errands, or even longer weekend trips around town.
Top Speed: 20 mph — Reach your destination faster while still adhering to city speed regulations. The A10 Pro’s top speed is ideal for urban settings, providing just the right amount of power to glide past traffic and stay ahead of the game.
Tires: 20” x 4.5 Kenda — These robust tires are built to handle a variety of terrains, providing excellent grip and traction on asphalt, cobblestone, or gravel paths. The larger contact surface area of the tires also contributes to a smoother and more balanced ride, making every trip a joy.
Built to Support Your Urban Adventures
Weighing in at just 68 lbs, the A10 Pro is easy to maneuver and store, making it a perfect fit for city dwellers with limited space. Despite its lightweight design, this e-bike has a maximum load capacity of 330 lbs, so you can comfortably carry groceries, bags, or even a child seat for family rides.
Why Choose A10 Pro?
The A10 Pro is more than just a means of transportation — it’s a lifestyle choice for modern urbanites. Its sleek, minimalistic design combined with high-end components makes it a standout in the crowded city bike market. Whether you’re a daily commuter or a casual rider looking to upgrade your city biking experience, the A10 Pro offers a seamless blend of comfort, performance, and reliability.
Make the City Yours
Forget about the hassle of finding parking, getting stuck in traffic, or relying on public transport. The A10 Pro gives you the freedom to explore the city on your terms. Enjoy the flexibility, reduce your carbon footprint, and transform every ride into an adventure.
The A10 Pro: Your dependable partner for every twist and turn the city throws your way.
